First Time Wine Tasting
Sep 2019
Met up with a friend here that work as a bartender and is experienced with wine. Chura's atmosphere was cozy, welcoming, and friendly. I had 5 different wines to try. My friend briefed me before hand on what to read before hand but you could just come to Chura without any preparation, Nhien and Nick will definitely take care of you. I brought a small notebook and pen to properly write down things as I try the wine. It was an eye-opening experience for me and I think I enjoyed wine even more when I have a better understanding of the grape types, location, weather, etc. Would highly recommend Chura.

Best Experience in Saigon!
Sep 2019 • Solo
Upon entering this up and coming establishment, I was greeted by Nick. He made me feel so welcome right away. Nhiên, a lovely young lady, helped me with a tasting of two whites, two reds and a rose. Between Nhiên and Nick, I was armed with a knowledge of lovely wines and paired with charcuterie board. I spoke with the owner as well, who was also very friendly! The music and ambiance was perfect and the other guests were just as happy as I to be here. If you’re in Saigon and you just have to have wine, this is the place to be. The selection is generous and the service can not be topped.
